title: Useful Web APIs: URL, FormData, structuredClone, AbortController
summary: Use browser-provided tools for URLs, forms, copying data, and cancellation.
nestedConcepts: Parse and build addresses with URL

subtopics.title: Parse and build addresses with URL
subtopics.explanation: The `URL` class parses an address into parts such as its origin, path, and query. You can update those parts without fragile string concatenation. For example, change a search parameter while preserving the rest of the current page address.

subtopics.title: Read query values with URLSearchParams
subtopics.explanation: `URLSearchParams` reads, adds, and removes query-string values with proper encoding. Use `get()` for one value and `getAll()` when a key can appear more than once. Do not assume query parameters are trusted; validate values before using them.

subtopics.title: Collect fields with FormData
subtopics.explanation: `FormData` gathers the named controls in a form into a submission-ready collection. It also supports files and repeated field names. Controls need a `name` to be included, and disabled controls are omitted, so confirm the form markup before sending it.

subtopics.title: Copy supported data with structuredClone()
subtopics.explanation: `structuredClone()` creates a separate copy of many built-in data types, including arrays, objects, maps, and dates. It can handle circular references, unlike JSON serialization. It cannot copy every value, such as functions, so use it only when the data fits the structured-clone rules.

subtopics.title: Cancel work with AbortController
subtopics.explanation: An `AbortController` sends a cancellation signal to `fetch()` and other APIs that support it. For example, abort an old search request when the user enters a newer query. Handle the resulting abort separately from a real network failure so cancellation does not appear as an error to the user.

foundations.overview: Web APIs are features provided by the browser alongside JavaScript. URL safely reads and changes address parts. FormData packages form values. structuredClone copies supported nested data. AbortController signals that work such as a fetch should stop.
foundations.mentalModel: These APIs are like standard tools already included in a workshop.
foundations.whyItMatters: Native browser tools solve common problems without custom parsing or dependencies.

keyTakeaways: FormData gathers form fields for submission.
structuredClone makes a deep copy of supported values.
AbortController can cancel fetch and other signal-aware work.
